scope: PlanarSrf joins open pieces and recovers closed walks, with rational segments, source provenance, application picking, exact planar staging and 3DM round trips.
baseline: New owned observation adapter with unchanged baseline command logic: three command successes among 35 pilot workflows. This is a status count, not a full parity count.

explicit_gap.checks: The oracle and application require the named decline and unchanged objects/history; the archive test skips that declared gap. All other status, area, source, boundary and history mismatches fail.

comparisons.sources: Source object identity retained exactly; full public NURBS source definitions at 1e-12.
comparisons.regions: One-to-one output/loop membership and multiplicity, output order canonicalized; areas at 1e-9 absolute plus 1e-12 relative.
comparisons.boundaries: Bidirectional used native spatial C3 edge witnesses at 17 stations per nonzero span, loop type and one-to-one pairing; 1e-6 gate. Live and restored outputs also compare native area.
comparisons.archive: All 121 qualified successful workflows saved as 3DM, output boundaries and areas checked after readback; live and restored B-reps generate audited normal meshes.
comparisons.application: 135 matching workflows plus the named gap; pure test_app with desktop display variables removed. Separate picking/delete/cancel test.
comparisons.delete_and_failure: Partial reversed aliases consumed; unused tails and diagonals retained; attributes, groups and one Undo/Redo step preserved. Oversized source controls decline atomically and preserve redo.

regressions.existing_tiny_circle_area_gap: crossing_circle10_small remains explicitly checked by its existing narrow exception; no widened area gate.
regressions.planar_mesh: Fresh command and pre/postselection checks in both builds; qualification report keeps 21 geometric matches, 10 full matches and 11 topology gaps per stage.

unqualified: Continuous curve-error bounds, native B-rep encoding and output birth order.
General rational endpoint-to-interior recovery, arbitrary self-intersections and broader branch networks.
Native render triangulation and comparative performance; normal-mesh generation is an internal audit.

execution.native: Six captures through tools/rhino_oracle/run_headless.sh exec, private Xvfb/i3 and private XDG runtime; successful observations never recaptured or rewritten before lossless compression.
execution.rust: DISPLAY, WAYLAND_DISPLAY, WAYLAND_SOCKET, SWAYSOCK and I3SOCK removed; no application event loop launched.
execution.workspace: Nine pre-existing untracked files retain their original SHA-256; AGENTS.md unchanged; README reviewed and remains accurate.
